observations: Single photo shows only the front headlight/fairing area of a scooter-style two-wheeler, green body with orange/yellow trim.
No full-body view, no side profile, no odometer, no engine/frame number, no license plate visible.
Background shows a compound wall and razor wire, consistent with a residential setting in Nigeria.
No brand or model lettering is legible anywhere in the image.

claims.evidence: Only a close-up of the front headlight is shown; no view of body panels, seat, tires or overall condition to confirm cleanliness.

claims.claim: Battery ran down, new owner will replace the batteries
claims.evidence: Stated by seller only; no photo of battery or dashboard showing dead state, but this is a self-disclosed defect so treated as true until shown otherwise.
Sentence is incomplete/unclear; no photo of a remote starter fob or ignition system shown.

risks.risk: Full body condition (scratches, dents, rust, tire wear) cannot be assessed from a single close-up shot.
risks.proof: Full side, rear, and seat/tire photos.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used/worst visible condition

risks.risk: Battery stated as dead; cost and type of replacement unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of battery compartment/battery brand, or receipt for replacement cost.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional, requiring battery replacement

risks.risk: Vehicle type (scooter vs standard motorcycle) is unclear, affecting which comparables apply.
risks.proof: Full-length photo showing frame type, wheel size, and body style.
risks.if_unproven: cannot reliably match to listed comparables

risks.risk: No registration plate, engine number, or ownership documents visible.
risks.proof: Photo of plate, engine number, and proof of ownership/registration papers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unregistered/unverified ownership, higher resale risk

proof_requests: Full side-view photo of the entire vehicle (both sides).
Close-up of engine/frame number and any brand markings.
Photo of the battery compartment and dashboard/instrument cluster.
Photo of registration plate and ownership documents.
Photo of tires and overall wear (seat, mirrors, exhaust).
response.reason: The single photo only shows a cropped headlight area, giving no way to confirm the vehicle's type, brand, overall condition, or match it reliably to any comparable listing, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a full-body photo.
